```python
def slugify(text):
    """Convert text to a 'slug': lowercase, replace spaces with dashes, remove punctuation."""
    import re
    # Convert to lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    # Replace spaces with dashes
    text = text.replace(' ', '-')
    # Remove all non-alphanumeric characters except dashes (which we just added)
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9-]', '', text)
    return text.strip('-')
```
